name: spryker-community/search-ranking-optimizer
description: Tuning layer for spryker-community/search-ranking: relevance-saturation-point (k) calibration (sample top-X search terms / top-Y results to compute the ranking formula's normalization constant), plus the planned SRP weight-slider preview, propose-review-apply workflow, rank_eval evaluation, and auto-tune job - deciding what the ranking parameters should be, on top of the mechanism that applies them.

scripts-descriptions.check-floors: Verifies the declared dependency floors are real: resolves every constraint to its oldest allowed version (production deps only) and asserts each vendor symbol used in src/ actually exists there.
scripts-descriptions.rector: Applies Rector's configured rule sets (PHP floor upgrades + level-0 dead-code/code-quality) to src/ and tests/.
scripts-descriptions.rector-dry-run: Shows what Rector would change without writing anything.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at level 8. Must be run from a host shop (see README) — needs the shop's generated Generated\Shared\Transfer\* classes and a freshly regenerated Ide/AutoCompletion stub, neither of which this package can produce standalone.
